Commentary.Commentary: Right. then. That is it from the coverage of this game. The Tigers have secured 30 crucial points from this ODI series away from home. But don't forget there is a T20I series to follow. As Zimbabwe will take on Bangladesh in the first of the three game T20I series on 22nd July, 2021 at 1030 GMT. Do join us for the live action. Till then cheers and goodbye!
The skipper Tamim Iqbal joins his team to lift the trophy and began the celebrations in Harare. Bangladesh have sealed the series in style.

Tamim Iqbal, Man of the Match says that he is delighted to contribute to the team. Says that it was a good wicket and they bowled well in the last 3 overs. Adds that keeping the World Cup in mind we had to chase this total. Mentions that he will not be a part of the T20I series due to an injury. Ends by wishing Eid Mubarak to everyone back home.

Shakib Al Hasan, Player of the series, says, It was always good to contribute to the team and always special to win against Zimbabwe in their own den. Says that the pitch was good to bat and he missed out on an opportunity today. Adds that in T20, they have to turn up to win the series.

Brendan Taylor is up for a chat. He says there are a lot of positives to take back from this series and will be ready for the upcoming series against Ireland. Says Raza came back from the injury and played an incredible knock. Ends by saying he wanted to give the ball to Blessing Muzarabani but Donald Tiripano was able to strike today. Also says Nurul Hasan took the game away from them.
...Presentation time...

Not a good start with the ball for the hosts, they had their moments in between but could not capitalize on it. Zimbabwe found the first breakthrough in the 14th over, as the spinner Wesley Madhevere drew the first blood. The pacers weren’t disciplined with the ball in the Powerplay 1, as they did not trouble the batsmen at all. But during the middle overs, Luke Jongwe came to the party and skittled out Shakib Al Hasan. It was then Donald Tiripano who struck twice in two deliveries. First, it was Tamim Iqbal who got trapped followed by the dismissal of Mahmudullah. Wesley Madhevere came back in the end to take one more wicket. The rest of the bowlers probed good lines and lengths but never got rewarded for their effort. Not the end the hosts were looking for.

The Tigers have chased down the target of 299 successfully. Bangladesh started off solidly with the help of their skipper Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das. But the latter had to depart due to a miscued sweep hit. Shakib Al Hasan was also sent back with just 30 runs to his name. It was all about Tamim Iqbal as he went onto score a century. But soon after he got off to Donald Tiripano and in the next delivery itself, Mahmudullah had to depart on a golden duck. Right, through the innings whenever they were put on the back foot, they managed well to recover quickly and get back on the driving seat. This time, it was the clumsy innings of Mohammad Mithun along with the power-hitter Nurul Hasan who build an important partnership to take their side well within the reach of the target. Afif Hossain’s small cameo, in the end, helped Bangladesh complete the whitewash and end the series with a 3-nil win.

So, Bangladesh won the game by 5 wickets, as they make complete use of this batting pitch in Harare to seal the series 3-0 and have made the clean sweep over Zimbabwe. They have also added 10 more points to the World Cup Super League table. The hosts fought till the end but it just wasn't their day with the ball today.

On a length, outside off. Iqbal cuts it through point. The pace of the ball did not let the fielder get a hold of it. The batters take a couple.
A length ball, on off, keeps it out solidly.
SIX! BANG! Making the optimum use of a free-hit. A touch short, on off. Iqbal stands tall and pulls it over the square leg fence for a maximum.

NO BALL AND FOUR BYES! This must've slipped out of his fingers. Serves a full toss, outside off, above waist height. Iqbal just watches it sail past him. The keeper also fails to collect it behind the stumps and the ball ends up in the fence at third man. Also, a free hit to follow.
A full length ball, on off. Das pushes it to cover for a single.
A full length ball, on the pads. Iqbal clips it to square leg for a run.

A length ball, on the pads. Iqbal tucks it to square leg. They run the first one hard, looking for the second. But the fielder does well to collect it quickly. The batters then decide to settle for a run.
Serves a length ball, on middle. Iqbal tucks it to mid-wicket but straight to the man.
A full length ball, outside off, Das pushes it to mid off and rotates the strike.
A good length ball, around the hips, Iqbal tucks it to mid-wicket and takes off for a single.
A length ball, on the pads. Das flicks it to square leg for a single.
Full length delivery, on the pads, Das flicks it to the left of the keeper, who moves to that side and makes the stop.
On a length, outside off. Das punches it to sweeper cover for another single. 8 runs off the over. Good batting by these two.
Back of a length ball, outside off. Iqbal stays back and upper cuts it towards third man. The ball meets the man in the deep on a bounce. Iqbal gets a single.
A full length ball, around off, nips in. Das stays back and guides it towards third man for a single.
A length ball, on the pads. Iqbal tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Another full ball on the pads. Iqbal flicks it to long on for another two runs.
Tiripano starts with a full ball on middle. Iqbal clips it to square leg with soft hands for a couple of runs.

End of Powerplay 1! Powerplay 2 begins! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, for Zimbabwe there is a bowling change. Donald Tiripano comes into the attack. He replaces Blessing Muzarabani.
Dot to end the over! A full ball outside off. Das drives it nicely but finds man at point. End of the Powerplay 1, Bangladesh are on 57 without any loss of wicket.
On the pads. Iqbal clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full on off. This is pushed to mid off.
A short of a length ball on middle. Das clips it to short fine leg who does well to get a hand on it. Single taken.
Serves a length ball, outside off. Das chops it to point.
Full and outside off. Das pushes it to point.
Luke Jongwe comes into the attack now. He replaces Tendai Chatara.
Fuller ball on the pads. Das flicks it wide of mid-wicket to end the over with a single.
Tad fuller around off. Das works it to the man at mid on.
On a length, outside off. Das punches it to point.
Again on the pads. Iqbal flicks it to square leg for a single.
Comes around the wicket and angles this one on a fuller length, on the pads. Iqbal tucks it to mid-wicket.
Touch fuller outside off. Das dabs it to third man for one.
FOUR! Big over for Bangladesh as 50 comes up for them! A short of a length ball outside off. Iqbal cuts it through point for another boundary. 19 runs coming of this over.
FOUR! Sheer Timing! A length ball around off. Iqbal prods forward and pushes it to the left of mid off for a boundary.
SIX! First maximum of the chase! A short of a length ball on the hips. Iqbal helps it away over fine leg as the fielder there sees it sail over him.
On a length, around off. Iqbal drives it nicely but the fielder at point does well to stop it.
On middle. Iqbal tucks it to mid-wicket. The fielder there half-stops and allows a couple of runs. Again, an awkward bounce leads to a half-stop.
Three taken! A full ball on middle. Das flicks it wide of square leg fielder. The fielder in the deep runs across and cuts it off. The batters take three runs.
Fuller ball around off. Iqbal defends it off the front foot towards cover.
On a length. on middle. Blocked out.
EDGY RUNS! A length ball outside off. Iqbal looks to push but gets a thick outside edge towards the third man fence for a boundary.
A short of a length ball outside off. Iqbal stands tall and cuts it to the point fielder who half-stops it on a bounce. The third man comes across and cuts it off. Two taken.
Touch fuller outside off. Iqbal defends it on the off side.
Good length ball outside off. Das opens his bat face and guides it to third man for one.
Around off, on a length. Iqbal pushes it to covers. Just 3 runs coming off it. Zimbabwe need many more overs like this.
Quick single! Another short of a length ball on middle. Das tucks it to mid-wicket and runs across.
Another short of a length ball on middle. Iqbal tucks it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
A back of a length ball on middle. Iqbal punches it to mid on.
Full ball on middle. Iqbal flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length, around off. Das pushes it through covers for a single.
A full length ball, leg, Iqbal glances it to fine leg. 9 runs off the over. Zimbabwe need to chip some wickets now. Before the batters settle in with ease.
FOUR! CRACKED! A touch short, outside off. Iqbal stays back and cuts it through covers for a boundary. This is HIS first boundary of the game.
A length ball, on middle. Das flicks it to the left of mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, Das pushes it to cover.
BEATEN! Nice comeback by Blessing Muzarabani. On a length, outside off. Das looks to go after it but misses. The ball goes to the keeper from under the bat.
FOUR! Lovely-looking stroke. Serves it straight on the pads. Das removes his front leg and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Moves to 15.
Another length ball, around off. Iqbal pushes it to cover.
A length ball, on off, pushed to mid off.
BEATEN! Beautiful movement on that one. Serves a length ball, around off, nipping away. Iqbal looks to defend it but misses.
IN THE AIR...SAFE! A length delivery, outside off. Das guides it uppishly towards third man but the ball fell short, The batters take an easy single.
Back of a length ball, on off, close to the body. Das hangs back and defends it out watchfully.
A full length ball, on off, Iqbal guides it to third man for a single.
A touch short, on off. Das defends it to third man.
A length ball, on off. Das defends it out solidly.
A length ball, on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.

There was a mix-up, and Iqbal would have been a goner, if the stumps were hitting. A length ball, on off, Iqbal pushes it to cover. He ventures out looking for a single, but he was sent back by Das. The fielder collects the ball and has a shy at the stumps but misses it.
Good length delivery, around off, moving away from the left-hander. Iqbal leaves it alone.
A length ball, on middle. Iqbal defends it back to the bowler with a straight bat.
FOUR! A good-looking shot. A good length delivery, around off. Das punches it through the point region for a boundary. 10 runs coming off the over.
Dishes A full delivery, on off. Das pushes it to mid off.
Serves it touch short, on off. Das hangs back and defends it out watchfully.
A length ball, on the pads. Iqbal glances it to fine leg for another single.
IN THE AIR...SAFE! A good length ball, outside off. Das cuts it uppishly towards backward point. The ball meets him on a bounce though. The batters cross.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Liton Das gets the first boundary of the chase. On a length, outside off. Das stays back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end with the second new ball? It is going to be Tendai Chatara.
A dot to end the over. A length ball, on off. Iqbal blocks it out solidly. Good first over by Blessing Muzarabani, just a single off it.
A good length delivery, outside off, moving away from the batsman. Iqbal shoulders his arms.
Back of a length ball, around off. Iqbal leaves it alone for the keeper.
A length ball, on off, Das flicks it to the right of mid on for a single. Bangladesh and Liton Das are off the mark.
Serves a full length ball, on middle, coming back in. Das looks to flick it away but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Down the leg.
Starts with a full length ball, on middle. Das tucks it to mid on but straight to the man.
